segment.source: Click to upload user's avatar, and validate size and format of picture with beforeUpload.
segment.target: Clique para envio usuário's avatar, e validate tamanho e format de picture com beforeUpload.

segment.source: Bind Files to provide an initial observable upload file list.
segment.target: Bind Arquivos para fornecer an initial observable envio arquivo lista.

segment.source: You can drag files to a specific area, to upload. Alternatively, you can also upload by selecting.
segment.target: Você pode arrastar arquivos para a specific area, para envio. Alternatively, você pode also envio por selecionando.

segment.source: Compose two UploadTrigger instances to select files and directories independently.
segment.target: Compose dois UploadTrigger instances para selecionar arquivos e directories independently.

segment.source: Limit files with maxCount. Will replace current one when maxCount is 1.
segment.target: Limit arquivos com maxCount. Irá replace atual um quando maxCount é 1.

segment.source: You can only upload JPG/PNG file!
segment.target: Você pode somente envio JPG/PNG arquivo!

segment.source: You can only upload PNG file!
segment.target: Você pode somente envio PNG arquivo!

segment.source: Upload supports composable file and directory triggers, drag-and-drop areas, observable Files state, picture lists, max-count constraints, success cleanup, and file type filtering.
segment.target: Envio oferece suporte composable arquivo e directory triggers, arrastar-e-drop areas, observable Arquivos estado, picture listas, max-count constraints, sucesso cleanup, e arquivo tipo filtering.

segment.source: Select, validate, preview, and upload files with list and picture presentations.
segment.target: Selecionar, validate, preview, e envio arquivos com lista e picture presentations.

segment.source: After users upload a picture, the thumbnail is rendered in the picture-card list and the trigger remains a separate append entry.
segment.target: Depois usuários envio a picture, o thumbnail é renderizado em o picture-cartão lista e o gatilho remains a separate append entrada.

segment.source: If uploaded file is a picture, the thumbnail can be shown.
segment.target: Se uploaded arquivo é a picture, o thumbnail pode ser shown.

segment.source: UploadList owns the scroll region, so long file lists do not require an outer ScrollViewer.
segment.target: UploadList owns o scroll region, so longo arquivo listas do não require an outer ScrollViewer.

segment.source: Each realized file container. The PictureCard and PictureCircle append trigger is not a file item.
segment.target: Cada contêiner de arquivo realizado. O gatilho de anexação de PictureCard e PictureCircle não é um item de arquivo.

segment.source: The active file list for every ListType, including the PictureCard and PictureCircle wrap layout.
segment.target: A lista de arquivos ativa para cada ListType, incluindo o layout de quebra de PictureCard e PictureCircle.

segment.source: Customize the Upload root, list region, and every realized file item with generated semantic styles.
segment.target: Personalize a raiz de Upload, a região da lista e cada item de arquivo realizado com estilos semânticos gerados.

segment.source: The Upload owner that coordinates the trigger and list layout through the Upload control contract.
segment.target: O proprietário Upload que coordena o gatilho e o layout da lista por meio do contrato do controle Upload.

segment.source: Use SuccessAutoRemoveDelay to remove successful files after a short delay.
segment.target: Usar SuccessAutoRemoveDelay para remover successful arquivos depois a curto delay.

segment.source: Classic mode. File selection dialog pops up when upload button is clicked.
segment.target: Classic modo. Arquivo seleção diálogo pops up quando envio botão é clicado.

segment.source: beforeUpload only prevent upload behavior when return false or reject promise, the prevented file would still show in file list. Here is the example you can keep prevented files out of list by return UPLOAD.LIST_IGNORE.
segment.target: beforeUpload only prevent upload behavior when return false or reject promise, the prevented file would still show in file list. Here is the example you can keep prevented files out of list by return UPLOAD.LIST_IGNORE.
